stories.summary: The capacity of gas-fired power plants currently being planned to supply power to US data centers nearly doubled in the first half of 2026. But it remains unclear if all of those plants will ultimately be built, since most projects are in early development and the demand surge has led to a bottleneck for gas turbines, with some suppliers warning of yearslong lead times. White House officials said they would cancel the visas of 200,000 asylum seekers, potentially representing the single largest mass visa revocation in US history . The Trump administration also proposed charging more than $100,000 for visas granted to skilled workers, despite bipartisan support for a program that has helped attract an array of talent to the US; an earlier effort ran into legal challenges.
